create_jax_kernel: create a JAX primitive from a Warp kernel with optional launch dimensions and quiet mode
register_warp_kernel: register a Warp kernel with the JAX primitive for GPU execution via custom call
lower_warp_call_to_mlir: lower a Warp kernel call to MLIR with GPU platform target and custom call target
build_warp_custom_callback: build a custom XLA callback that parses opaque descriptors and launches Warp kernels on CUDA
test_jax_version_compatibility: test JAX version compatibility and raise errors for unsupported versions below 0.4.25 or above 0.7.x
